channel.title: Sharliz Tower news
channel.description: What's new in Sharliz Tower, straight from the dev team.

item.title: Out now on the App Store!
item.description: Sharliz Tower is here, free on iPhone and iPad. Android is coming soon to Google Play.

item.title: Meet the Sharliz cast
item.description: Bobby, Lulu, Mimi, Timmy, Nunu and Rocky got their names and a shiny new look. Each one has a personality of their own, and you'll be seeing a lot more of them soon.

item.title: The Sharliz House is finished
item.description: Four cozy rooms, 25 pieces of furniture and 225 designs to mix and match. Every piece gives your Sharliz a power, and there are 6 house styles, from a cozy cottage to a candy house.

item.title: 400+ stickers to collect
item.description: The sticker album grew to over 400 stickers. The super-rare gold chapter can only be filled by finishing missions, so every sticker in it is earned, never bought.

item.title: Two new arcade games
item.description: Sling Shot and Who's in the Shadow? joined the arcade. Quick mini games for a break from building towers.

item.title: Now in 14 languages
item.description: Sharliz Tower now speaks 14 languages, including English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Arabic and Hebrew. Kids everywhere can play in their own language.

item.title: Holiday events are coming
item.description: Special events get their own map, shop and boss. Halloween is first, with a spooky boss waiting at the top.
